name: QTT Marketing Settings
description: Connection to QTT's marketing automation (n8n) for QTT OS → QTT Admin → Marketing. Editable here or from the app by Platform Owners. The API key is never returned to the app.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off hides workflow data in QTT Admin without removing the key.

fields.label: n8n API Key
fields.description: From n8n → Settings → n8n API. Server-side only.

fields.label: Job applications project
fields.description: Project whose Tasks are Gayathri's job applications (e.g. PROJ-0004). Empty = not counted.

fields.label: Approval resume user
fields.description: Basic-auth user on the n8n 'Wait for decision' steps (credential 'QTT OS approval resume').

fields.label: Approval resume password
fields.description: Printed once by marketing-ai-os/18_AUTOMATIONS/APPROVALS/patch_approvals.py. Lets Frappe continue a waiting n8n run after a decision.
